base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT c."XCL_002" AS name, c."XCL_006" AS artist,
       CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c."XCL_022" = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(c."XCL_001") AS percentage
FROM cards AS c
INNER JOIN legalities AS l ON c."XCL_072" = l."XCL_086"
WHERE l."XCL_084" = 'commander' AND l."XCL_085" = 'Legal'
  AND (c."XCL_055" IS NULL OR c."XCL_055" = '*')
GROUP BY c."XCL_002", c."XCL_006"

        FROM cards c2
        JOIN legalities l2 ON c2.XCL_072 = l2.XCL_086
        WHERE l2.XCL_085 = 'commander'
          AND (c2.XCL_012 IS NULL OR c2.XCL_012 = '*')
    ) AS percentage
FROM cards c
JOIN legalities l ON c.XCL_072 = l.XCL_086
WHERE l.XCL_085 = 'commander'
  AND (c.XCL_012 IS NULL OR c.XCL_012 = '*')
